text:
anya: PTAL — I pushed a follow-up that addresses the earlier comments on retry jitter + backoff. I also pulled the circuit-breaker checks into retry_manager.py and added unit tests. Diff: https://git.redwood/xyz/pr/4821
simon: looking now, thanks. quick skim — tests look good. did you keep the old env var fallback?
anya: yes — RETRY_BASE_MS and RETRY_MAX_MS still supported, added RETRY_POLICY=v2 to opt in to the new behavior. docs updated in README.md
maria: can you paste the new default backoff math here? hard to parse from code during call.
anya: sure: default policy = min(max(base * exp(k*attempt) * (1 + uniform(-jitter, jitter)), base), max). with k=0.55 and jitter=0.12 by default. I added a comment block and a quick table in the README.
simon: nit: s/0.55/0.5/ would be easier to reason about but i don't feel strongly. else LGTM.
leo: CI failing on the integration test that simulates partial node failures — looks like the circuit-breaker state doesn't reset fast enough for the harness. can you add a small backoff reset window or make tests tolerant?
anya: thanks — that test exposes an actual race. I pushed a tiny change to reduce the cooldown from 60s -> 15s for unit/integration mode only (ENV=TEST_MODE toggles it). PTAL at the updated test harness too.
merge-bot: build 4821-5 started — running: unit, lint, integration (timeout 30m)
maria: tests are passing locally for me with the cooldown tweak. good call on TEST_MODE toggling.
simon: approved — leaving the small k tweak to follow-up if perf shows regressions :thumbsup:
anya: thanks! anyone able to grab the merge window today? I'd like to canary this on staging before EOD.
leo: i can take the merge handoff at 2pm PT and monitor staging for 30m.
anya: awesome — i'll wait for CI green and then ask ops for a canary slot. merging in ~5m after CI passes unless anyone objects.
merge-bot: build 4821-5: unit ✓, lint ✓, integration ✓
anya: merging now. will post rollback instructions in #incidents if anything odd shows up.
simon: thanks, great cleanup.
leo: on it — will ping here with staging metrics in ~35m.
